Game Overview

Tiny Boxes puts players into a arcade experience centered on swap and slide your way to victory in Tiny Boxes, a charming puzzler that challenges you to connect colorful blocks in strategic rows and columns. Master your moves to score big, and aim for three stars by visualizing future drops and optimizing every action. Simple, yet highly satisfying fun!
